name: comp-205
title: Select With Icon
blurb: Select with leading icon positioned inside the trigger.
description: Select with Label, SelectTrigger with ClockIcon positioned at start, and SelectContent with time range options. Uses absolute positioning for icon.
use_when: You need visual context for the select via an icon (e.g., time picker, location).
avoid_when: When the select purpose is obvious without icons.
a11y: Icon marked aria-hidden. Label linked via htmlFor. Full keyboard navigation.
